metadata.title: How To: Microfiber Towel Folding Trick | Masterson's Car Care | Best Microfiber Towels
metadata.description:
Microfiber towels are an amazing tool for any detailing professional or enthusiast. Many detailers often use microfiber towels wrong, leading to misusing towels and poor technique. Today, Greg shows your the proper trick if how to fold a microfiber towel. The 4-fold towel trick will turn one how into four towels! The technique will improve your detailing speed, deliver better results, and reduce the use of microfiber on the job. The trick will save you time and change your detailing forever. Masterson's Car care believes in creating quality detailing supplied backed with professional knowledge to keep your vehicle looking great all year! Enjoy the video, and SUBSCRIBE TODAY!!!

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a man kneeling on the driveway and speaking towards the camera. He begins with a blue towel, and then puts a cleaning solution into the blue bag. After that he uses the bag and solution to clean the side of the car.

The video is well lit, with a palm tree and red flowers in the background. It is bright and clear.

summary.brief: The presenter folds a blue microfiber towel, uses the folded towel with spray to clean a car, and promotes the technique.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the Masterson’s Car Care logo, then cuts to a man in a black T‑shirt, sunglasses and jeans kneeling beside a silver convertible. He holds up a blue 16 × 16 microfiber towel, folds it lengthwise and then folds it again to form a compact square that provides a plush, cushioned surface. He explains that the fold creates eight usable sides and demonstrates each side by flipping the towel and wiping the car’s paint. He sprays Masterson’s detail spray onto the folded towel, presses the plush side onto the vehicle, glides it to lift dirt, then flips to a fresh side and repeats until all eight sides have been used. Throughout the demonstration he points out the extra cushion and thicker feel of the folded towel. After the cleaning demonstration he talks about the benefits of the trick, encourages viewers to use fewer towels, and ends with a call to subscribe, followed by a closing Masterson’s Car Care logo and an end‑screen graphic.

action.detailed: Fold the blue microfiber towel twice into a compact square, spray the car’s surface with detail spray, press the plush side of the folded towel onto the paint and glide it to remove dirt, then flip to a fresh side and repeat until all eight sides have been used.
action.actor: The presenter (the man in the black T‑shirt)

At the end, he holds it in both hands before he begins to unfold it. The background is bright blue sky with trees and a building visible in the distance.

summary.brief: Greg kneels beside a car and demonstrates how to fold a blue microfiber towel.
summary.detailed: After a brief opening with the Masterson's Car Care logo, Greg – a detailer in a black T‑shirt, sunglasses and blue jeans – appears kneeling in front of a silver convertible on a sunny driveway. He explains that many people misuse microfiber towels, gives the towel a quick wipe with Masterson’s detail spray, and then shows a 16 × 16 blue silk‑lined towel. He folds the towel lengthwise, folds it again to form a neat square, holds the folded square up to display its plush thickness, and describes how the extra cushion improves detailing performance. The background includes a clear blue sky, palm trees, a light‑colored wall and another vehicle.

After using the cloth to dry the car, he puts it down, picks up the spray bottle, and repeats the process, several times more, as he talks about the process. At the end of the video, a 'Subscribe' button pops up on screen.

summary.brief: The presenter folds a blue microfiber towel, sprays it, and wipes a car while using all eight sides of the folded cloth.
summary.detailed: A man in a black T‑shirt, blue jeans and sunglasses kneels beside a silver convertible on a sunny driveway. He takes a blue 16 × 16 microfiber towel, folds it lengthwise and then folds it in half again to create a compact square. Graphic text appears that reads “8 Sides!”. He sprays Masterson’s detail‑spray onto the plush side of the folded towel, then presses the towel against the car’s surface and wipes in smooth motions. He repeatedly flips the towel to expose each of its eight sides, re‑applying spray as needed while pointing to different panels of the vehicle. Throughout the segment he puts the towel down, picks up the spray bottle, and repeats the process several times. Near the end a “Subscribe” overlay appears, followed by the Masterson’s Car Care logo and ending cards.

summary_sent_to_llm.title: How To: Microfiber Towel Folding Trick | Masterson's Car Care | Best Microfiber Towels
summary_sent_to_llm.description: Microfiber towels are an amazing tool for any detailing professional or enthusiast. Many detailers often use microfiber towels wrong, leading to misusing towels and poor technique. Today, Greg shows your the proper trick if how to fold a microfiber towel. The 4-fold towel trick will turn one how into four towels! The technique will improve your detailing speed, deliver better results, and reduce the use of microfiber on the job. The trick will save you time and change your detailing forever. Masterson's Car care believes in creating quality detailing supplied backed with professional knowledge
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video opens with the Masterson’s Car Care logo, then cuts to a man in a black T‑shirt, sunglasses and jeans kneeling beside a silver convertible. He holds up a blue 16 × 16 microfiber towel, folds it lengthwise and then folds it again to form a compact square that provides a plush, cushioned surface. He explains that the fold creates eight usable sides and demonstrates each side by flipping the towel and wiping the car’s paint. He sprays Masterson’s detail spray onto the folded towel, presses the plush side onto the vehicle, glides it to lift dirt, then flips to a fresh side and repeats until all eight sides have been used. Throughout the demonstration he points out the extra cushion and thicker feel of the folded towel. After the cleaning demonstration he talks about the benefits of the trick, encourages viewers to use fewer towels, and ends with a call to subscribe, followed by a closing Masterson’s Car Care logo and an end‑screen graphic.
